title: Business Security Deposit: Additional Amount Due and Its Installments
content:
**Clause.** The additional amount due on a business Security Deposit returned to assessed by a recalculation is the required amount recorded on the deposit less the held cash, which is the cash received less the cash refunded, and never below zero. It is paid in the most installments of the deposit's kind, each the additional amount due divided by that count and rounded down to the cent, the last installment carrying the remainder.

The installment paid first is rounded to the cent and never exceeds the additional amount due. After the installment paid first, the rest of the additional amount due is paid in equal installments over the remaining number, each rounded down to the cent, the last carrying the remainder, each due 30 calendar days after the previous one.


## Worked examples (hypothetical deposits)

**Kind allowing 2 installments.** Required amount recorded USD 7757.00; cash received USD 5000.00; nothing refunded. Held cash USD 5000.00. Additional amount due USD 2757.00. Each installment USD 2757.00 divided by 2, which is USD 1378.50; the installment paid first is USD 1378.50 and the second, due 30 calendar days later, is USD 1378.50.

**Odd cent.** Additional amount due USD 2757.01 over 2 installments: USD 1378.505 rounded down to USD 1378.50 for the first; the last carries the remainder, USD 1378.51.

**Kind allowing 1 installment.** Required amount recorded USD 62000.00; cash received USD 52000.00; an excess refund of USD 2000.00 paid earlier. Held cash USD 50000.00. Additional amount due USD 12000.00, paid as one installment of USD 12000.00.

**Required amount below the held cash.** Required amount recorded USD 4000.00 and held cash USD 4200.00: the additional amount due is zero, never a negative figure.
